blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and October 2026, detached houses: listings fell from 52 in June to 46 in October (−11.5%), and it took 11.7% of the city’s 247 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings fell from 43 in June to 36 in October (−16.3%), and it took 14.8% of the city’s 230 sales over the period.

The monthly write-ups singled out Cottonwood for detached houses in October (a sellers’ best bet); detached houses in July (a buyers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in July, August (a sellers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in June, September (a buyers’ best bet).

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Cottonwood Maple Ridge than in June?
faq.a: In Cottonwood Maple Ridge, listings of houses fell from 52 in June to 46 in October (−11.5%); condos and townhomes fell from 43 in June to 36 in October (−16.3%).

faq.q: How big is Cottonwood Maple Ridge compared with the rest of Maple Ridge?
faq.a: In October 2026, Cottonwood Maple Ridge held 11.9% of the 388 houses listed in Maple Ridge and 13.4% of the 268 condos and townhomes listed in Maple Ridge.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Cottonwood Maple Ridge from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 29 houses and 34 condos and townhomes sold in Cottonwood Maple Ridge over those 5 months.
